names: Hack squat day — hack squat + accessories, 15,206 kg
Front squat day — front squat + accessories, 9,335 kg

en.eNote: No meals logged for Aug 19 – Aug 25 (last intake log: Jun 14), so the energy and burn charts assume the 2,000 kcal plan. Garmin active burn averaged ~387 kcal/day, essentially flat on the ~385 of the Aug 22 board. Thursday's hack squat day is still the biggest day at 741, Monday's swim added 675, Friday's swim 614, Sunday's front squat day 572, Wednesday and Saturday were true rest days at 62 and 45, and today reads 1 — nothing recorded yet this morning.
en.bNote: Net exercise = Garmin active calories; standing BMR 2,414 (today's Garmin BMR reads 732 because the day just started). Intake assumes 2,000 kcal all seven days (none logged after Jun 14), so the implied balance ≈ −801 kcal/day is exercise-driven, not measured. Thursday alone implies ≈ −1,155, Monday ≈ −1,089 and Sunday ≈ −986. Today (Aug 25) has barely started.
en.wNote: Bridge shows the last logged meals (Jun 12–14) — no intake was logged for the displayed week. Negative balance = deficit.
en.i1t: Four sessions again, but the week reshaped itself around a weekend gap
en.i1: 4 sessions across 4 active days, 4h 30m and ~2,710 active kcal, against 4h 48m and ~2,698 kcal on the Aug 22 board. Session count holds at four and tonnage is up 365 kg, but the rhythm changed: the clean lift/swim alternation of the previous window gave way to a two-day weekend gap and then a back-to-back Sunday–Monday block. Thursday hack squat, Friday swim, Saturday rest, Sunday front squat, Monday swim, and nothing yet today. Monday's swim was the most efficient piece of the window — the same 2,225 m as Friday but in 59 minutes instead of 63, at an identical average HR of 131 versus 130, with max HR down to 157 from Friday's 169. Same work, less time, lower peak. Wednesday (62 active kcal, max HR 102) and Saturday (45 kcal, max HR 98) were clean rest days.
en.i2t: A front squat appeared; trap-bar and goblet gaps are still open and now 66 and 75 days
en.i2: Thursday 10:16–11:25 — 74 minutes, 737 active kcal, avg HR 123, max 155. Twenty sets, 206 reps, 15,206 kg: hack squat 60×6, 100×6, 140×3, then three work sets at 160×12 to RPE 9.5, plus lying leg curl, barbell bench, lat pulldown and seated shoulder press. Sunday 10:24–11:14 — Hevy logs 50 minutes of working time inside a 74-minute Garmin activity, 642 active kcal, avg HR 116, max 158. Nineteen sets, 202 reps, 9,335 kg, built on front squat: 60×6 at RPE 6, then 80×8 three times at RPE 8, 9 and 8.5, plus seated cable row, machine chest press, seated leg curl, lateral raise and bicep curl. The front squat is a new entry in the log and a genuinely different pattern from the hack squat — free-standing, trunk-loaded, and it went to RPE 9 on the second work set. It is not, however, one of the three tracked lifts, so the per-set HR chart gains nothing from it: the newest point there is still Thursday's hack squat (six sets, estimated peaks 117, 123, 130, 140, 136, 151, avg 120), still flagged uncertain because the peaks were binned from the HR stream rather than matched set by set. Both open gaps widened by three days: trap-bar deadlift is 66 days out from Jun 20, goblet squat 75 days out from Jun 11. Friday's board called trap-bar the session for that day; Saturday was taken as rest and Sunday went to front squat instead, so it is still outstanding.
en.i3t: Two nights went unrecorded — the board sat still from Saturday to Monday
en.i3: Hevy and Intervals.icu were both synced at the start of this refresh; Hevy holds full set-by-set data for both lifting days, so 15,206 kg and 9,335 kg are measured rather than estimated, and Intervals had nothing new to add. The gap in this window is on the sleep side: Garmin has no sleep record for calendar dates Aug 23 or Aug 24, meaning the Saturday-evening and Sunday-evening nights were never captured. The morning gate waits on last night's sleep before refreshing, so with nothing to find on Sunday or Monday the dashboard simply held at the Aug 22 snapshot for three days. The sleep chart now shows the seven most recent recorded nights and visibly jumps from Friday evening to Monday evening. Training data itself is complete — the two swims and both lifts all came through. Wearing the watch overnight on weekends is all this needs.
en.i4t: Recovery: length restored, depth still the open question
en.i4: Last night scored 80 on 8h 00m — the longest night of the seven, 1h 04m above the 6h 56m average, off a 22:20 bedtime that was the earliest of the window. Garmin grades duration and REM excellent; deep, light, awake count, restlessness and stress all fair. Deep sleep was only 50 minutes, 10% of the night and 69 down on Friday's 119, while REM ran to 108 minutes. Six wake episodes totalled 28 minutes for 94% efficiency. HRV at 41 is back on the 42 baseline rather than below it, and RHR at 54 is three under the 57 posted on both Sunday and Monday — the right direction two days after a hard squat session. Overnight stress 18, second-lowest of the window. Readiness 76, good.
en.rec: Trap-bar deadlift is now 66 days overdue and it has been the standing item on this board for weeks. This morning's numbers support it: readiness 76, HRV back on baseline at 41, RHR down to 54 from the 57 of both training days, overnight stress 18, and eight hours of sleep behind it. It is not the emphatic green light Friday was, but it is a solid one, and waiting for a better window has already cost three weeks. Do it today. The caveat is Sunday's front squat, which went to RPE 9 on 80×8 and will have left the quads and trunk with some residue — so treat today as a hinge day and open conservatively: ramp to a work weight you would have called an easy triple in June, cap the top sets at RPE 7–8, and take it as re-entry rather than a test of where the number sits after two months off. Log every set in Hevy. Thursday's hack-squat point is still an estimate flagged uncertain, and a properly logged trap-bar session would give the per-set HR chart its first clean point since Jun 20. Goblet squat, at 75 days, is the next gap; slot it Thursday or Friday with a swim between. On the recovery side, hold the 22:20 bedtime — it produced the longest night on the board and it is the one change that has worked. And wear the watch on weekend nights: two blank nights this window left the dashboard frozen from Saturday to Monday. Next: trap-bar DL today at RPE 7–8, log every set, goblet squat later this week, keep the early bedtime, wear the watch overnight.

hr.eNote: Nema zabilježenih obroka za 19.–25.8. (zadnji unos: 14.6.), pa grafovi energije i potrošnje pretpostavljaju planskih 2.000 kcal. Garmin aktivna potrošnja prosječno ~387 kcal/dan, praktički nepromijenjeno u odnosu na ~385 s ploče od 22.8. Četvrtkov dan hack čučnja i dalje je najveći dan sa 741, ponedjeljkovo plivanje dodalo je 675, petkovo 614, nedjeljni dan prednjeg čučnja 572, srijeda i subota bili su pravi dani odmora sa 62 i 45, a danas piše 1 — jutros još ništa nije zabilježeno.
hr.bNote: Neto trening = Garmin aktivne kalorije; standardni BMR 2.414 (današnji Garminov BMR pokazuje 732 jer je dan tek počeo). Unos pretpostavlja 2.000 kcal svih sedam dana (ništa zabilježeno nakon 14.6.), pa je implicirana bilanca ≈ −801 kcal/dan posljedica treninga, ne mjerena. Sam četvrtak implicira ≈ −1.155, ponedjeljak ≈ −1.089, a nedjelja ≈ −986. Danas (25.8.) tek je počelo.
hr.wNote: Most prikazuje zadnje zabilježene obroke (12.–14.6.) — za prikazani tjedan nema unosa. Negativna bilanca = deficit.
hr.i1t: Opet četiri treninga, ali tjedan se preoblikovao oko vikend praznine
hr.i1: 4 treninga kroz 4 aktivna dana, 4h 30m i ~2.710 aktivnih kcal, naspram 4h 48m i ~2.698 kcal na ploči od 22.8. Broj treninga ostaje četiri, a tonaža je veća za 365 kg, ali ritam se promijenio: urednu izmjenu dizanja i bazena iz prošlog prozora zamijenila je dvodnevna vikend praznina pa uzastopni blok nedjelja–ponedjeljak. Četvrtak hack čučanj, petak bazen, subota odmor, nedjelja prednji čučanj, ponedjeljak bazen, a danas još ništa. Ponedjeljkovo plivanje bilo je najučinkovitiji dio prozora — istih 2.225 m kao u petak, ali u 59 minuta umjesto 63, uz identičan prosječni puls 131 naspram 130 i maksimum spušten na 157 s petkovih 169. Isti posao, manje vremena, niži vrh. Srijeda (62 aktivne kcal, maksimalni puls 102) i subota (45 kcal, maksimalni puls 98) bili su čisti dani odmora.
hr.i2t: Pojavio se prednji čučanj; pauze u trap-baru i goblet čučnju i dalje su otvorene, sada 66 i 75 dana
hr.i2: Četvrtak od 10:16 do 11:25 — 74 minute, 737 aktivnih kcal, prosjek 123, maksimum 155. Dvadeset serija, 206 ponavljanja, 15.206 kg: hack čučanj 60×6, 100×6, 140×3, pa tri radne serije na 160×12 do RPE 9,5, uz pregib potkoljenice ležeći, potisak sa šipkom, lat mašinu i potisak za ramena sjedeći. Nedjelja od 10:24 do 11:14 — Hevy bilježi 50 minuta radnog vremena unutar 74-minutne Garmin aktivnosti, 642 aktivne kcal, prosjek 116, maksimum 158. Devetnaest serija, 202 ponavljanja, 9.335 kg, oslonjeno na prednji čučanj: 60×6 uz RPE 6, pa tri puta 80×8 uz RPE 8, 9 i 8,5, uz veslanje na kabelu sjedeći, potisak za prsa na spravi, pregib potkoljenice sjedeći, bočno podizanje i pregib za biceps. Prednji čučanj nov je unos u zapisu i doista drukčiji obrazac od hack čučnja — slobodan stav, opterećenje na trupu, a otišao je do RPE 9 u drugoj radnoj seriji. Ipak nije jedan od tri praćena pokreta, pa graf pulsa po serijama od njega ne dobiva ništa: najnovija točka ondje i dalje je četvrtkov hack čučanj (šest serija, procijenjeni vrhovi 117, 123, 130, 140, 136, 151, prosjek 120), i dalje označen kao nesiguran jer su vrhovi grupirani iz niza pulsa, a ne podudarani seriju po seriju. Obje otvorene pauze produljile su se za tri dana: trap-bar mrtvo dizanje 66 dana od 20.6., goblet čučanj 75 dana od 11.6. Petkova ploča proglasila je trap-bar treningom toga dana; subota je uzeta za odmor, a nedjelja je otišla na prednji čučanj, pa stavka i dalje stoji otvorena.
hr.i3t: Dvije noći ostale su nezabilježene — ploča je mirovala od subote do ponedjeljka
hr.i3: Hevy i Intervals.icu sinkronizirani su na početku ovog osvježavanja; Hevy ima potpune podatke po serijama za oba dana dizanja, pa su 15.206 kg i 9.335 kg izmjereni, a ne procijenjeni, dok Intervals nije donio ništa novo. Praznina u ovom prozoru je na strani sna: Garmin nema zapis sna za kalendarske datume 23.8. ni 24.8., što znači da noći od subote i nedjelje navečer nikad nisu zabilježene. Jutarnja provjera čeka sinoćnji san prije osvježavanja, pa je ploča, ne našavši ništa u nedjelju ni ponedjeljak, jednostavno ostala na snimci od 22.8. tri dana. Graf sna sada prikazuje sedam najnovijih zabilježenih noći i vidljivo preskače s petkove večeri na ponedjeljkovu. Podaci o treningu su potpuni — oba plivanja i oba dizanja stigla su. Dovoljno je nositi sat preko noći i vikendom.
hr.i4t: Oporavak: duljina vraćena, dubina i dalje otvoreno pitanje
hr.i4: Sinoćnja noć ocijenjena je 80 uz 8h 00m — najdulja noć od sedam, 1h 04m iznad prosjeka od 6h 56m, uz lijeganje u 22:20, najranije u prozoru. Garmin ocjenjuje trajanje i REM izvrsnima; duboki, laki, broj buđenja, nemir i stres svi su osrednji. Duboki san bio je samo 50 minuta, 10% noći i 69 manje od petkovih 119, dok je REM narastao na 108 minuta. Šest buđenja zbrojilo se na 28 minuta uz 94% učinkovitosti. HRV od 41 vratio se na osnovicu od 42, a ne ispod nje, a RHR od 54 tri je ispod 57 zabilježenih i u nedjelju i u ponedjeljak — pravi smjer dva dana nakon teškog čučnja. Noćni stres 18, drugi najniži u prozoru. Spremnost 76, dobra.
hr.rec: Trap-bar mrtvo dizanje sada kasni 66 dana i tjednima je stalna stavka na ovoj ploči. Jutrošnji brojevi ga podupiru: spremnost 76, HRV natrag na osnovici od 41, RHR spušten na 54 s 57 koliko je bio oba dana treninga, noćni stres 18 i osam sati sna iza toga. Nije to nedvosmisleno zeleno svjetlo kakvo je bio petak, ali je čvrsto, a čekanje boljeg prozora već je stajalo tri tjedna. Odradi ga danas. Ograda je nedjeljni prednji čučanj, koji je otišao do RPE 9 na 80×8 i ostavio nešto umora u kvadricepsima i trupu — zato shvati današnji dan kao dan pregiba u kuku i otvori konzervativno: rastući do radne težine koju bi u lipnju nazvao laganom trojkom, ograniči gornje serije na RPE 7–8 i uzmi to kao povratak, a ne kao test toga gdje je broj nakon dva mjeseca pauze. Zabilježi svaku seriju u Hevyju. Četvrtkova točka za hack čučanj i dalje je procjena označena kao nesigurna, a uredno zabilježen trap-bar trening dao bi grafu pulsa po serijama prvu čistu točku od 20.6. Goblet čučanj, na 75 dana, sljedeća je pauza; stavi ga u četvrtak ili petak uz bazen između. Na strani oporavka, zadrži lijeganje u 22:20 — donijelo je najdulju noć na ploči i jedina je promjena koja je upalila. I nosi sat vikendom preko noći: dvije prazne noći u ovom prozoru zamrznule su ploču od subote do ponedjeljka. Sljedeće: trap-bar DL danas uz RPE 7–8, bilježi svaku seriju, goblet čučanj kasnije ovaj tjedan, zadrži rano lijeganje, nosi sat preko noći.
